meeting.summary: Members approved the June 2, 2026 minutes by voice vote.
meeting.recap: Members approved the June 2, 2026 minutes by voice vote.[[0:13:30]] He said the project still lacks the land rights it needs after 30 years.[[0:16:54]] State highway staff presented a 2026 update to the state's Transportation Asset Management Plan.[[0:29:35]] Proposed two-year targets for national highway system pavement are 25% good and 4% poor.[[0:41:28]] Proposed bridge targets are 30% good and 4% poor.[[0:43:59]] Staff said they expect about 20% less funding for these bridges.[[0:53:26]] The chair said they could not back the full plan without seeing it.[[0:58:08]] The next committee meeting is September 1, 2026 at 9:00 a.m.[[1:08:36]]
decided: Members approved the June 2, 2026 minutes by voice vote.
meeting.next: Staff said they will still share the final draft plan with members for review. State staff said they expect a final plan report by August. The chair asked members to explain their departments' roles at the September meeting.
